sentences.text: Seeing the mountain is possible from afar.
The viewing was short today.
I remember a good viewing.
Hearing music is pleasant.
Hearing sharpens in the dark.
Hearing the birds starts in the morning.
Knowing a language helps when traveling.
Knowledge comes from books.
At school knowledge grows.
Deep thinking needs quiet.
Thinking solves a problem.
In the evening thinking is slow.
Smelling a flower is pleasant.
The smell sense is strong in the kitchen.
Smelling bread wakes hunger.
A child has fear of the dark.
Fear fades slowly.
Fear of dogs is understandable.
Deep sleep restores strength.
Sleep is better at night.
A child's sleep is peaceful.
Living in a village is peaceful.
Life changes every day.
Living together is not easy.
Death is part of nature.
A plant's death happens in winter.
Death frightens everyone.
Killing is forbidden in the forest.
I do not want killing of insects.
Killing is a cruel act.
The fight in the yard stopped.
A fair fight is rare.
Fighting uses up strength.
Hunting in the forest starts early.
Winter hunting is hard.
Hunting is regulated by law.
Hitting the ball is loud.
A hit on the door was heard.
A strong hit moves the table.
Cutting bread is done with a knife.
Careful cutting is safe.
Cutting paper is easy.
Splitting firewood needs strength.
Splitting with an axe is quick.
Splitting a stone is hard.
Stabbing is a dangerous action.
Stabbing into meat happens in the kitchen.
Stabbing is done with a knife.
A cat's scratch is light.
Scratching leaves a mark on skin.
Scratching an itch is not allowed.
Digging earth starts in the garden.
Deep digging takes time.
Digging with a shovel is easier.
Swimming in the lake is refreshing.
Swimming is pleasant in summer.
A child's swimming is learned slowly.
A bird's flight is light.
Flying in the sky is free.
An airplane's flight is long.
Walking in the park is healthy.
Slow walking suits a tired person.
An evening walk changes the air for you.
A friend's coming makes us glad.
The coming was late because of rain.
A quick coming is impossible.
Lying on the sofa is comfortable.
Lying down helps rest.
Lying on the grass is pleasant in summer.
Sitting on a chair is restful.
Long sitting bothers the back.
Sitting by the window is bright.
Standing in line takes a long time.
Standing strengthens the legs.
Standing on the bus is tiring.
Turning the key opens the door.
A turn to the left is necessary.
A quick turn causes dizziness.
A leaf's fall is in autumn.
Falling on ice is painful.
The fall of rain is heard on the roof.
Giving a gift brings joy.
Giving is a sign of generosity.
Giving bread helps a hungry person.
Holding a glass is done carefully.
Holding in the hand needs strength.
Holding a child must be safe.
Squeezing a lemon gives juice.
Squeezing by hand is simple.
Squeezing clothes removes water.
Rubbing the hands gives warmth.
Rubbing can irritate the skin.
Rubbing ointment is done slowly.
Washing clothes happens weekly.
Washing with soap is better.
Washing hands before eating is important.
Wiping the table leaves it clean.
Wiping with a damp cloth is quick.
Wiping the window makes it bright.
Pulling the door needs strength.
Pulling with a rope is easier.
Pulling a box on the floor is noisy.
Pushing the door opens it inward.
Pushing in a line is rude.
Pushing a bicycle uphill is hard.
Throwing a ball goes far.
Throwing into the bin keeps things tidy.
Throwing a stone into the river is heard.
Tying a rope makes a knot.
Tying is necessary on shoes.
Tying a box with tape is firm.
Sewing clothes takes time.
Sewing with a needle is careful work.
Sewing on a button is easy.
Counting apples is quick.
Counting to a hundred is hard for a child.
Counting money needs attention.
Saying the truth is important.
Saying it aloud lets everyone hear.
Saying thanks is a good habit.
Singing a song opens the heart.
Singing in a choir is more beautiful.
A child's singing fills the house.
Playing ball is in the yard.
Playing with friends is cheerful.
Evening playing is short.
A leaf's floating on water is slow.
Floating on the river is calm.
A boat's floating is a sway on the waves.
The flow of water in the river is fast.
Flow comes down from the mountain.
Slow flow is in the lake.
Freezing of water is in winter.
Freezing turns the lake to ice.
Quick freezing is in the freezer.
Swelling of the foot makes walking hard.
Swelling comes after an injury.
Swelling lessens with cold water.
The sun rises in the morning.
The sun warms the room.
The sun hides behind a cloud.
The moon shines at night.
A full moon is large.
The moon moves slowly in the sky.
A bright star is in the sky.
A star is visible at night.
A small star is far away.
Clean water is in the jug.
Water comes from the river.
Cold water kills thirst.
